## eca9af4f6c53

**Reproduced defect: advertised cardinality and palette controls are accepted but ignored.**

Audited generator SHA-256:
`ce203c3aec10977649011ff3b9eac7685cd6a457e7c8320ebf173e839810cc5b`.
Across seeds 0–19 at medium difficulty, `n_blocks=1` and `n_blocks=9`
produced byte-identical grids in 20/20 comparisons. Every `n_blocks=1`
request contained more than one block. Likewise, `palette_size=1` and
`palette_size=9` produced byte-identical grids in 20/20 comparisons, and every
`palette_size=1` request used more than one foreground color. All probed outputs
passed the generator's `self_check`.

The source-level cause is concrete: `AXES` advertises `n_blocks`, but
`generate()` draws the unrelated key `"blocks"`; `palette_size` is never read.
The minimal source-bound reproducer and all 20 rows are retained in
`checks/audit/eca9af4f6c53/probe_declared_axes.py` and
`checks/audit/eca9af4f6c53/declared-axis-probe.json`. This is an audit finding
only; no file under `generators/eca9af4f6c53/` was modified.

The optional combined audit preset completed but did not pass. Its task-test stage
reported `no_tests` (exit 5), and its strict semantic stage reported no declared
semantic contract (exit 2); see
`checks/audit/eca9af4f6c53/combined/checks/eca9af4f6c53_audit_summary.json`.
These scope failures neither approve nor invalidate the concrete axis reproducer.
